title: Learning Graph Defect Finder
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Examine a 16-concept dependency graph and flag the concepts that have one of four structural defects.

learningObjectives: The learner will examine a 16-concept dependency graph and mark the concepts that have one of four structural defects, finding all 4 defects with no more than 1 false flag.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Concept 1 and concept 14 both have no prerequisites. Explain why only one of them is a defect.
commonMisconceptions: A concept with no prerequisites is always a defect.
A label at the limit is over it.
Two concepts whose labels differ only in case are different.
A cycle is visible only as one edge.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is all 4 defects found, with no more than 1 flag on a concept that is not in the answer key.
